title: How Did Jesus Start His Day? | WMSCOG, Church of God, Ahnsahnghong, God the Moth

segs.en: There was a man named Oda Nobunaga in Japan.
segs.text: There was a man named Oda Nobunaga in Japan.

segs.en: Every day he would wake up at dawn and ride the fastest horse for about 10 miles.
segs.ko: 그는 매일 새벽에 일어나 가장 빠른 말을 타고 약 10마일을 달렸습니다.
segs.text: Every day he would wake up at dawn and ride the fastest horse for about 10 miles.

segs.en: He would cover that 10-mile distance, always strategizing on the way there and making decisions on the way back.
segs.ko: 10마일을 달리는 동안, 갈 때는 늘 전략을 구상하고 돌아올 때는 결단을 내렸습니다.
segs.text: He would cover that 10-mile distance, always strategizing on the way there and making decisions on the way back.

segs.en: It became a part of his daily routine.
segs.text: It became a part of his daily routine.

segs.en: In the past, Japan was also divided into various regional powers that were not united.
segs.ko: 과거 일본 또한 하나로 통일되지 못한 채 여러 지역 세력으로 나뉘어 있었습니다.
segs.text: In the past, Japan was also divided into various regional powers that were not united.

segs.en: That period is referred to as the waring states period.
segs.text: That period is referred to as the waring states period.

segs.en: He is credited with unifying Japan into a single nation.
segs.ko: 그는 일본을 하나의 나라로 통일한 주역으로 꼽힙니다.
segs.text: He is credited with unifying Japan into a single nation.

segs.en: He also thought I should start earlier than others.
segs.ko: 그는 또한 '남들보다 먼저 시작해야 한다'고 생각했습니다.
segs.text: He also thought I should start earlier than others.

segs.en: This is why he always woke up early in the morning.
segs.ko: 이것이 그가 언제나 이른 아침에 일어났던 이유입니다.
segs.text: This is why he always woke up early in the morning.

segs.en: Very early in the morning while it was still dark, Jesus got up, went off to a solitary place where he prayed.
segs.ko: 날이 밝기 전 이른 새벽, 예수님께서는 일어나 한적한 곳으로 가셔서 기도하셨습니다.
segs.text: Very early in the morning while it was still dark, Jesus got up, went off to a solitary place where he prayed.

segs.en: He always said, "Let us go somewhere else to the nearby villages so I can preach there also.
segs.ko: 그분은 늘 "가까운 다른 마을들로 가자, 거기서도 복음을 전해야 하리라"라고 말씀하셨습니다.
segs.text: He always said, "Let us go somewhere else to the nearby villages so I can preach there also.

segs.en: That is why I have come."
segs.text: That is why I have come."

segs.en: Isn't it true that God has watched over the spread of the gospel from the beginning?
segs.ko: 하나님께서는 처음부터 복음이 전파되는 과정을 지켜보고 계시지 않았습니까?
segs.text: Isn't it true that God has watched over the spread of the gospel from the beginning?

segs.en: I hope that you and I can be those who fulfill the completion of the gospel.
segs.ko: 저와 여러분이 복음의 완성을 이루어 가는 사람들이 되기를 소망합니다.
segs.text: I hope that you and I can be those who fulfill the completion of the gospel.
